d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav men endie ko bari jit milti huee dikh rahi hai. vahin dusri taraph mahagathbandhan ka pradarshan nirashajnak raha hai. bihar chunav men aae is tarah ke natijon ki tin bari vajhen kya ho sakti hain. bibisi sanvaddata sumedha pal ne yahi janne ki koshish ki.
Vidiyoh seraj ali
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
